messages:
incidentbot: PAGER (PD-9876) - inference-gateway/us-west1 reporting 5xx spike. 2m 5xx_rate=17% (threshold 10%). 3m avg latency 450ms. auto-page to #incidents. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/inference/5xx-spike

alice: ack. I'm oncall and looking. pulling up dashboards and logs.

ben: i see the spike started ~8076543240. errors concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat streams. throwing 502s with upstream reset.

carla: confirmed increased connection resets from kv-cache proxy in us-west1 cluster. might be an eviction storm.

alice: quick impact check: ~12% of global traffic routed to us-west1, but the error spike there is pushing overall customer errors to ~3.2% global. specific customers flagged in PD: cust-phi3 (high), cust-alpha (medium).

dylan: oncall infra here — running the runbook step: restarting kv-cache sidecars on the three affected nodes.

ben: doing a conservative mitigation: adding a temporary route weight shift away from us-west1 (20% -> 2%) to reduce load. pushing route change now.

carla: note: a single upstream client (app-id: mobile-alpha) is opening many long-poll connections to /v1/generate; behavior looks like runaway retry loop. we should throttle at the edge.

alice: applying emergency rate-limit at the gateway for /v1/generate: per-client 30r/s, 429 fallback. new envoy config snippet:
```
- name: per_client_rate_limit
  match: { path: "/v1/generate" }
  actions: { type: local_ratelimit, limit: 30 }
```

eve: support here — notifying affected customers: cust-phi3 support ticket created and updated. asked them to check client release rollout.

frank: metrics update: 5xx rate in us-west1 dropping from 17% -> 6% in the last 90s after route-shift + rate-limit. latency back to 310ms.

alice: good. keep monitoring for 10m. i'll keep this thread updated and then hand off to night oncall at 8076543445.

carla: found a spike of peer evictions on node-12 due to memory pressure; investigating whether recent model shard changed footprint. opening an infra ticket.

ben: PD note: acknowledged by alice. escalation chain paused. adding note to PD incident about temporary routing and rate-limit.

eve: customers notified: cust-phi3 confirmed they rolled back a client change and are seeing success.

frank: final check: us-west1 5xx rate stabilized to 1.8% at 8076543440. global 5xx back to baseline 0.9%.

alice: planning next steps: 1) revert route weights gradually 2) remove emergency rate-limit after 30m stability 3) postmortem to cover root cause (kv-cache eviction + client retry pattern). linking postmortem stub: https://redwood.incidents/pm/PD-9876-draft

alice: handing off to dylan for the night watch and follow-up. summary pinned in PD. dylan please ack handoff.

dylan: ack — i'll be on watch, will review infra ticket and coord with support if cust escalates. moving thread to monitoring channel for next 30m. :thumbsup:

incidentbot: INCIDENT UPDATE (PD-9876) status -> mitigated. auto-note added: route-shift + rate-limit. further investigation assigned to infra (carla) and eng-ml (alice).
